text_block_list.text: During summer camp...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! Do you have time tonight?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: The thing is...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Oh, it's Mayano. ☆
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Oh, Marvey! Heyo! ☆
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Haha. It's marvelous to see you. ☆
What's up? ★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
(This is Marvelous Sunday. She's a pal of
Mayano
Top Gun's who debuted at the
same time.)
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's go to the festival tonight. ☆ I've
invited
Nature as well.★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
Hey, now hold on just a minute,
whippersnapper. I
didn't say I'd go.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Little details like that don't matter! ☆
Anyway,
what time should we meet up,
Mayano?
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Oh, um... Actually...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I think I'll pass this time! I'm gonna do
some secret
training with my trainer
tonight!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Huh?!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Is that so?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: When did I say yes to that?

text_block_list.text: You were just about to!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Nature, Marvey, you two have fun at the
festival
without me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Let's go, Trainer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Oh my... It looks like our twinkly young
friend is
quite passionate about her
trainer.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Hello? Marvelous?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: How maaarvelous!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Wah?!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Mayano is so wonderfully marvelous! ☆
She just
showed me a new way to be
marvelous! ★
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Come again?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Nature! We have to follow her lead! We
need to
train so she doesn't surpass us!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text:
We must strike while the iron is
marvelously
hot! ☆ Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday

text_block_list.text: Wh-what?! D-don't drag me into this!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Pant... Huff...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ok, that's three sets down! What's next,
Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Fyuuuuu!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hm? What was that?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: BAM! BOOM, BOOM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh! It's fireworks! Look, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Haha! They must be pretty big for us to
be able
to see them from here.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I wonder how pretty they'd be
from up
close.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You wanted to go to that festival after all, huh?

text_block_list.text: ...Nope! I'm totally okay.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: I can go to the festival some other time.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Once I've made your heart flutter after I
win the
Kikuka Sho, that is!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You'll have to work hard if you want to win.

text_block_list.text:
Once I've made your heart flutter after I
win the
Kikuka Sho, that is!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган
choice_data_list: You'll have to work hard if you want to win.

text_block_list.text: Wha?! Really? But...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I haven't made it flutter enough! I can do
better!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna make you fall in love with me
so hard
you won't be able to live without
me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Heh! You'd better look forward to it,
Trainer! ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Hmph. I'll have you know I already got
that race
in the bag. ♪
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'm in the middle of a growth spurt,
y'know! It's
only a matter of time.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I'll win the Kikuka Sho and any other
race! You'll
totally be entranced by me!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
When we come back next summer, I'm
gonna give
you the most grown-up
present on this beach...
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Fyuuu! BOOOOOM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Huh? They're still going off?
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Why're you interrupting me with all your boom, boom, booms?! Read the room!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: BOOOOOM!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Sigh... The atmosphere was so good just now! Geez!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган furiously stomps up
and down,
directing her rage at the
fireworks...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Saying this, Маяно Топ Ган takes off
running
on the beach once more.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
